item_id.description: The anchor item to explore from. Typically obtained from a tribal_discover result.

session_trace_id.description: Trace ID from a prior tribal_discover call. If provided, this explore is part of the same retrieval session. The returned trace_id will match. Use this to build coherent feedback across discover + explore workflows.

direction.description: Traversal direction relative to the anchor item.

relation_types.description: Filter to specific relation types. Omit to return all types.

depth.description: Maximum traversal hops from anchor. 1 = direct relations only.

include_standing.description: Compute standing for each returned item. Adds latency at depth > 1.

include_references.description: Return references attached to each item.

limit.description: Maximum total results across all depths. Closer relations are returned first.
